data.name: Mildrid
data.long_meaning: The name Mildrid is derived from Old English elements mild, meaning gentle, and hrid, meaning ruler. In medieval England, this name was borne by a few women and is now considered rare. The name was also borne by a saint, Saint Mildred, who was a 7th-century virgin and abbess in England.

For those named Mildrid, this name serves as a reminder to embody the calm and gentle strength of Christ in all areas of life.
